company.fundacion: 2014 (Hong Kong). Pivote a BESS para construcción en 2018; primer Enertainer desplegado en 2019.
company.mision_en: Delivering high-performance power for heavy industries with zero compromises.
ods: ODS 7 Energía asequible y no contaminante

why_bess_vs_diesel: Sin CO, NOx ni PM: mejor calidad del aire en faena
Sin riesgo de derrames de diésel · probado a UL9540A
Hasta 32x más silencioso: horarios de operación sin restricción
10–30 % menor costo total de operación (hasta 80 % en OPEX según sitio)
O&M remota en una sola plataforma
Mínimo downtime: sin reabastecimiento, redundancia integrada

mineria.argumento: Generador + BESS opera en su ventana de eficiencia o solo pocas horas al día; payback ≈ 2 años con garantía de 5.

puertos.argumento: Alternativa a generadores sobredimensionados en ralentí que queman combustible, elevan mantención y generan emisiones innecesarias.

resumen_web.construccion: Problemas comunes de energía por dependencia del diésel causan retrasos y sobrecostos.
resumen_web.mineria: Los generadores sufren en entornos con peaks; la minería tiene más picos, sobrecargas y volatilidad de lo que se cree.
resumen_web.infraestructura: Túneles, obras ferroviarias y montajes demandan potencia muy variable, inadecuada para diésel.
resumen_web.hormigon: Reduce ineficiencia, desperdicio de combustible y desgaste por cargas erráticas.
resumen_web.oil_gas: Perfil de potencia altamente volátil; generador + Ampd es la solución óptima.
resumen_web.microtuneleria: Precisión absoluta y soporte a picos de alto torque.
resumen_web.eventos: Ampd como buffer silencioso del generador: sin ruido, vibración ni humos.
resumen_web.puertos: Alternativa a generadores sobredimensionados en ralentí.

testimonials.quote_en: The Enertainer worked perfectly from the very beginning. Not only did we vastly reduce our CO2 emissions–a key focus for Gammon–but we did so with a lower OPEX. Even though this was the first time we deployed this technology, the performance data reporting system of the Enertainer gave us confidence.
testimonials.author: Andy Wong
testimonials.role: Head of Digital G, Gammon Construction

testimonials.quote_en: Deploying the Ampd Energy Enertainers at Olympia has been a game-changer in reducing carbon and maximising power reliability and availability at the site. Each Enertainer has removed a 500 kVA generator and all its associated emissions, noise, space, and cost.
testimonials.author: Ian Fleming

testimonials.quote_en: No product offers similar features as Ampd, which provides the reliability and stability that the construction industry needs.
testimonials.author: Ke-Vin Lim

testimonials.quote_en: Over the past few years, Ampd has consistently demonstrated highly reliable performance and met the project team's needs.
testimonials.author: Ir Dr Stewart Wan
testimonials.role: Head of Innovation, Gammon | GM, Digital G

testimonials.quote_en: All in all, the Ampd ESS has had a massive impact in a positive way, particularly for the environment.
testimonials.author: Darrell Cullen

testimonials.quote_en: By introducing an Ampd unit to replace 2 diesel generators, we were able to achieve reliable electricity supply for 24 hours/7 days operation without worrying about any overheating issues. On top of that, we achieved operational cost savings and more than halved our carbon emissions.
testimonials.author: Roy Khoo
